name: vLLM
qwen_support: Broad. Official FP8 and most NVFP4 quants. Community mixed-precision quants sometimes need a fork.
gotchas: Tool calling requires --enable-auto-tool-choice explicitly; SGLang does not.
The single-Spark 180B builds rely on memory-mapping the embedding lookup table from disk, which is a builder patch, not stock vLLM behaviour.
